card.line: Assyria was a strong empire north of Babylonia along the Tigris River, whose kings attacked Israel and Judah and carried the Israelites away from their land.

moments.title: Ahaz Asks Assyria for Help
moments.text: Under attack from Aram and Israel, King Ahaz sent messengers to the king of Assyria. He also sent silver and gold from the LORD's house. Assyria captured Damascus, and Ahaz went there to meet the Assyrian king.

moments.title: Hoshea Pays Assyria
moments.text: Shalmaneser king of Assyria attacked Hoshea, who then served him and paid him money each year. Later Hoshea stopped paying and sent messengers to Egypt for help, so the king of Assyria put him in prison.

moments.title: Israelites Taken to Assyria
moments.text: The king of Assyria surrounded Samaria for three years and then captured it. He carried the Israelites away to Assyria and settled them in Halah, Gozan, and the cities of the Medes.

moments.title: Sennacherib Attacks Judah
moments.text: Sennacherib king of Assyria captured the strong, walled cities of Judah. Hezekiah sent him silver and gold, even stripping the gold from the temple doors, but Assyria still sent a great army to Jerusalem.

moments.title: Hezekiah Prays, Isaiah Answers
moments.text: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD about the Assyrian threat, saying the kings of Assyria had destroyed other lands. Isaiah sent word that the LORD had heard his prayer about Sennacherib king of Assyria.
